title: ResearchOS Relation
description: Evidence relation E_t(H x O) -> {support, refute, neutral, unresolved} (SHELDON reading contributions/2026-10-21_sheldon_reading.md section 5.1). One record per (hypothesis, observation) pair. Written by an independent adjudication step, never derived mechanically from VER records (section 5.4). Since 2026-10-21 a relation in a non-exempt file must also declare derived_from (was this observation used to generate the hypothesis? then it cannot support it) and searched_refutation (did the adjudicator look for a refuting observation, as opposed to finding none?).

derived_from.description: True when this observation was one of the hypothesis's generation inputs. The verdict is still recorded honestly; the flag only keeps the aggregation from counting it as independent support.

searched_refutation.description: True when the adjudicator actively looked for evidence that the hypothesis is false. Distinguishes 'no refutation found' from 'no refutation searched for'.
